title: Ambient mates and pullback coordinates for intrinsic etale origins
statement: For finite commutative coefficients A and a scheme morphism p:Z→Y, construct the ambient right mate b:R_e F_Y→F_Z P_A from the site counit mate and the specified intrinsic realization/direct-image comparisons [def-fix-proper-etale-origin-scalar-data]. Define a:F_Y L_A→L_e F_Z as the inverse mate of b. Its counit identity holds on every unbounded input; on bounded-below input for qcqs p, b is the specified properOriginMateIso. For φ:A→B construct the composite scalar pullback s from the restriction and extension pullback maps [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], the etale constant-coefficient tensor pullback t, and the natural tensor comparison q whose components are properOriginTensorIso. These definitions use real composites, never arbitrary witnesses.

def originRealizationPushIso (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ Y) :
    (Scheme.sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Z A).functor ⋙ directImageConstantPush A p ≅
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) p).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
        (Scheme.sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y A).functor
